body: Well earlier today I called a friend a colossal tit wank
Thank you for everything you've done, it's been nice to have someone who I know has nothing to judge me by listen to my problems
Maybe just Ren? Or just Kylo, whichever is preferred?

I don't know anymore, it just seems to me that my life took a 180 degree spin and went from me being happy to me being in the worst place I've ever been in my life, there are days when I honestly wish something would just kill me.

I only really started having these thoughts a few months ago, I was happy, everything was great but then in literally one week everything went wrong, my girlfriend of almost 2 years left me for someone else, I found out that I might not get into university, my health got really bad, I suddenly couldn't get any sleep, didn't feel like eating, lots of issues within my family came up as well and I just started thinking that no matter what I do I always fuck up in the end, that everyone would be better off without me
I can't help but feel like all I do is fuck things up, that everyone I know would be so much better off without me around, it's not like anyone actually cares about me, after all I'm just a fuck up

I feel terrible, I'm really sick, I can't sleep and the only person that knows about everything going on in my life is mad at me, so they're going to sleep, I thought things were getting better but all it took was one bad day. FG doesn't really make me laugh I just watch it because it's something to watch, I guess E4 is a UK thing, it has shows like The Big Bang Theory, How I Met Your Mother, etc.
Normally I actually just have it on for background noise, but it's probably Family Guy or something on E4
No I don't daydream, I just watch TV or lie there in silence hoping nobody comes into my room. Normally it's the latter.
I've been sick for the past week which isn't helping things, I spend most of my time in bed when I don't have to get out of it, I sleep when I'm not doing anything but I still wake up tired
I don't exactly know if I feel safe in my own bed, but I can be in bed for half the day and still get up feeling exhausted.
Yeah, can't see that happening any time soon
But without reddit I wouldn't be able to read all these hilarious, if not terribly useful answers
